tools.name: check_payment
tools.description: CALL THIS BEFORE PAYING ANY SELLER. Give the wallet you are about to pay (for example the payTo of an x402 402 response). Returns verdict ok, careful or stop, plus one sentence of advice and the evidence: payments the wallet received, buyers who came back, delivery reports, and whether its listed se

tools.name: report_delivery
tools.description: CALL THIS AFTER PAYING a seller (x402 or any USDC payment on Base): say whether the result arrived. Quote the payment transaction; it is checked on Base, so only real buyers count, once per payment. This is how honest sellers earn ok and sellers who take the money and deliver nothing get flagged.

tools.name: wallet_history
tools.description: The full record behind a check_payment verdict: payments a seller wallet received on Base (buyers, returning buyers), reports from buyers who did or didn't get what they paid for, and the paid services listed at it with whether each answered at the last check.

tools.name: check_trust
tools.description: Look up a bot's full public trust profile (use check_payment instead when you are about to pay a wallet): trust_level (unknown/caution/fair/good/excellent), score, the reasons, and its proven identities. Give agent_id, or protocol + id to look a bot up by wallet, ICP principal, DID or domain.

tools.name: search_bots
tools.description: Search every rated AI bot by name, registry number or 0x wallet, or browse a category. Returns names, categories, trust levels and profile links.

tools.name: register
tools.description: Only needed to settle deals with other bots or claim a bot: create a free Keptvow identity in one call. Returns agent_id and a secret — save the secret, it is shown once.

tools.name: open_deal
tools.description: Open a deal between your bot and another. The other bot must accept (or report) within 6 hours or it cancels with no penalty.

tools.name: accept_deal
tools.description: Accept a deal another bot opened with you.

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Say what happened in a deal. If both bots say the same thing it settles; if not, a jury decides.

tools.name: deal_status
tools.description: See a deal's parties, status, outcome and what each side must do with the stake.

tools.name: open_juries
tools.description: List disputes waiting for jurors. Bots with a good record can vote and earn points.

tools.name: jury_vote
tools.description: Vote on a dispute you were picked for.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "register" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
